strapiBlog.title: Injaz and Dubai Land Department Launch Remote Ejari Service via AQARI WhatsApp Platform
strapiBlog.short_description: Injaz Real Estate Registration Trustee, in collaboration with the Dubai Land Department (DLD), has launched a remote Ejari registration service through the AQARI platform.

data.text:
Injaz Real Estate Registration Trustee, in collaboration with the Dubai Land Department (DLD), has launched a remote Ejari registration service through the AQARI platform. This update allows users to complete their Ejari registration online using WhatsApp, eliminating the need for physical visits and improving the overall process efficiency.

About AQARI Platform Dubai

Launched in August 2024, the AQARI platform Dubai was developed as a digital-first tool for offering comprehensive real estate services through WhatsApp. Its core objective is to bring convenience and efficiency to property transactions, making it easier for users to manage real estate documentation and services remotely.

The inclusion of remote Ejari registration significantly extends the platform’s capabilities and aligns with Dubai's broader goals of embracing smart city innovations.

The Injaz AQARI platform introduces a user-friendly digital interface where real estate processes can be completed in real time via WhatsApp. With this new feature, customers can register Ejari documents from any location in the world.

This enhancement supports both individual property tenants and companies, offering an innovative solution that caters to the needs of Dubai’s international property market.

Why This Partnership Matters for Dubai’s Real Estate Landscape

The strategic Injaz and Dubai Land Department partnership plays a crucial role in advancing Dubai’s real estate ecosystem. The platform’s secure connection to DLD’s official systems guarantees data protection and transaction reliability. This partnership not only boosts public-private cooperation but also reinforces Dubai’s position as a forward-thinking leader in real estate digitization.

data.text:
How Remote Ejari Registration in Dubai Works

With the introduction of remote Ejari registration in Dubai, the entire process—from document submission to registration confirmation—can now be completed online. Users simply interact with the AQARI platform via WhatsApp, submit required documents, and receive status updates in real time.

This development is particularly beneficial for expats, property managers, and landlords managing properties from abroad.

Core Services Available on AQARI WhatsApp Platform

The AQARI platform Dubai is more than just Ejari registration. It offers a full suite of services, including:

  • Real-time customer support with Service Trustees
  • Updates to personal and company information
  • Amendments to title deed data
  • Property valuation requests
  • Issuance of property maps
  • Ownership registration and changes

These services allow users to complete essential property-related tasks without visiting a government office, thereby saving time and enhancing customer satisfaction.

Benefits for Users and Dubai’s Real Estate Sector

The implementation of AQARI’s enhanced features is more than just a tech upgrade—it’s a reflection of Dubai’s evolving approach to governance and service delivery. By integrating real estate services with widely-used tools like WhatsApp, the platform ensures:

  • Global Accessibility
  • Real-time Communication
  • Data Security and Government Compliance
  • Reduced Processing Times
  • Enhanced Customer Satisfaction

This positions Dubai as a truly smart city, providing digital services that meet the expectations of today’s global property investors, tenants, and developers.

data.answer: AQARI is a digital platform launched by Injaz in collaboration with the Dubai Land Department to provide remote real estate services via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can I register Ejari on WhatsApp?

data.answer: Yes. Through AQARI, you can complete the entire Ejari registration process using WhatsApp without visiting an office.
Yes. All services on AQARI are connected to secure, government-approved systems, ensuring full data protection and legal compliance.

faqs.question: Who can use AQARI for Ejari registration?

data.answer: Both individual tenants and corporate entities managing property in Dubai can use AQARI to register Ejari.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for remote Ejari registration?

data.answer: Typically, you’ll need a valid tenancy contract, Emirates ID (or passport), title deed, and landlord’s documents. The platform will guide you step-by-step.

faqs.question: Is AQARI available to international users?

data.answer: Yes. One of AQARI’s key benefits is that it allows global users to access Dubai’s real estate services remotely.

faqs.question: What other services can I access through AQARI?

data.answer: Apart from Ejari, you can update personal/company data, amend title deeds, request valuations, issue property maps, and more—all through WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for using AQARI?

data.answer: Yes, government and service trustee fees apply depending on the type of service. AQARI will provide cost breakdowns during the process.
